recipes.name: Chicken & Rice Stir-Fry
recipes.method: Stir-fry diced chicken breast with onion and carrot, add frozen mixed veg, serve over cooked rice.
steps: Rinse 1½ cups rice and cook in 3 cups of water: bring to the boil, cover, and simmer on low for 12 minutes, then rest off the heat.
Dice the chicken breast into bite-sized pieces and season with salt and pepper.
Heat a splash of oil in a wok or large pan over high heat. Stir-fry the chicken for 5–6 minutes until golden and cooked through, then set aside.
Add the sliced onion and carrot to the pan and stir-fry for 3 minutes until just tender.
Tip in the frozen mixed veg and cook 2–3 minutes, then return the chicken and toss everything together.
Season with soy sauce if you have it, and serve over the rice.
recipes.tip: Keep the pan very hot and don't overcrowd it — the chicken should sizzle, not steam.

recipes.name: Lentil Curry
recipes.method: Simmer lentils with onion and canned tomatoes until soft, season as a curry, serve with rice.
steps: Rinse 1½ cups dried lentils under cold water and pick out any stones.
Gently fry the diced onion in oil over medium heat for 5 minutes until soft and golden.
Stir in curry powder or any spices you have (cumin, turmeric, chilli) and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the lentils, canned tomatoes and 3 cups of water. Bring to the boil, then simmer for 25–30 minutes, stirring now and then, until the lentils are soft.
Meanwhile cook the rice. Season the curry with salt to taste and serve spooned over the rice.
recipes.tip: Curry tastes even better the next day — it makes a great batch-cooked lunch.

recipes.name: Egg Fried Rice
recipes.method: Scramble eggs, mix through fried rice with diced carrot, onion and mixed veg.
steps: Use cold, cooked rice — day-old rice works best. If you're cooking it fresh, spread it on a tray to cool and dry out.
Beat the eggs with a pinch of salt.
Heat oil in a wok over high heat, pour in the eggs and scramble softly. Remove while still slightly runny.
Stir-fry the diced onion and carrot for 3 minutes, then add the frozen mixed veg for 2 minutes.
Add the rice and toss over high heat for 3–4 minutes until hot and lightly crisp.
Fold the egg back through, season with soy sauce, and serve.
recipes.tip: Fresh, warm rice turns mushy — cold rice gives you those separate, toasty grains.

recipes.name: Tuna & Chickpea Salad
recipes.method: Toss canned tuna and chickpeas with diced onion and a drizzle of olive oil.
steps: Drain and rinse the chickpeas, then pat them dry.
Drain the canned tuna and flake it into a large bowl with a fork.
Finely dice the onion. Soak it in cold water for 5 minutes to soften its bite, then drain.
Add the chickpeas and onion to the tuna.
Drizzle with olive oil, season generously with salt and pepper, and toss. Add a squeeze of lemon if you have one.
recipes.tip: This keeps well in the fridge for 2 days — a solid meal-prep lunch.

recipes.name: Tofu Scramble
recipes.method: Crumble and pan-fry tofu with onion, carrot and mixed veg, season like scrambled eggs.
steps: Drain the tofu and press it between paper towels to remove excess water.
Heat oil in a non-stick pan and soften the diced onion and grated carrot for 3 minutes.
Crumble the tofu into the pan with your hands, into pieces the size of scrambled egg.
Add the frozen mixed veg and cook 4–5 minutes, stirring, until the tofu is lightly golden.
Season with salt, pepper and a pinch of turmeric (for colour) and serve.
recipes.tip: A pinch of turmeric gives it a sunny, egg-like colour; a splash of soy sauce adds depth.

recipes.name: Beef Mince Pasta
recipes.method: Brown beef mince with onion, simmer in canned tomatoes, serve over pasta.
steps: Bring a large pot of salted water to the boil for the pasta.
Brown the beef mince in a hot pan over medium-high heat for 5–6 minutes, breaking it up with a spoon.
Add the diced onion and cook 3–4 minutes until soft.
Pour in the canned tomatoes, season with salt, pepper and dried herbs, and simmer for 15 minutes.
Meanwhile cook the pasta until al dente. Drain, keeping a splash of the pasta water.
Toss the pasta with the sauce, loosening with pasta water if needed, and serve.
recipes.tip: Let the mince brown properly before stirring — the crusty bits are where the flavour is.

recipes.name: Greek Yogurt Oat Bowl
recipes.method: Combine oats with Greek yogurt, top with sliced banana.
steps: Spoon about 1 cup of Greek yogurt into a bowl.
Stir through ⅓ cup of rolled oats. Leave for 5 minutes to soften, or overnight in the fridge.
Slice the banana and arrange it on top.
Add a drizzle of honey or a sprinkle of cinnamon if you like.
recipes.tip: Make it the night before — the oats soak up the yogurt and turn creamy.

recipes.name: Cottage Cheese Toast
recipes.method: Spread cottage cheese on toasted bread, serve with apple slices.
steps: Toast two slices of bread until golden.
Spread a generous layer of cottage cheese on each slice.
Season with cracked black pepper and a pinch of salt.
Slice the apple and serve on the side, or thinly on top of the toast.
recipes.tip: Try apple slices on top with a pinch of cinnamon for a sweet version.

recipes.name: Chicken Baked Potato
recipes.method: Bake potatoes, top with shredded cooked chicken breast and steamed mixed veg.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C. Scrub the potatoes, prick them all over with a fork, and rub with oil and salt.
Bake for 45–50 minutes until the skins are crisp and the insides are soft.
Meanwhile season the chicken breast and pan-fry it for 6–7 minutes per side until cooked through. Rest it, then shred with two forks.
Steam or microwave the frozen mixed veg until hot.
Split the potatoes open, fluff the insides, and pile on the chicken and veg.
recipes.tip: Microwave the potatoes for 8 minutes first, then roast for 20, to save half the time.

recipes.name: Salmon Rice Bowl
recipes.method: Flake canned salmon over rice with sauteed carrot and onion.
steps: Cook the rice, then fluff it with a fork.
Thinly slice the onion and cut the carrot into matchsticks.
Sauté the onion and carrot in a little oil for 4–5 minutes until tender-crisp.
Drain the canned salmon and flake it, removing any large bones if you prefer.
Build bowls: rice first, then the veg and salmon. Finish with soy sauce or a squeeze of lemon.
recipes.tip: The soft bones in canned salmon are edible and full of calcium — just mash them in.

recipes.name: Baked Beans on Toast
recipes.method: Heat baked beans, serve on toast topped with grated cheese.
steps: Warm the baked beans in a small saucepan over medium heat, stirring occasionally.
Toast the bread.
Grate the cheese.
Spoon the hot beans over the toast and top with cheese. Pop it under the grill for a minute to melt, if you like.
recipes.tip: A pinch of smoked paprika or chilli flakes makes this a lot more exciting.

recipes.name: Chickpea Pasta Bake
recipes.method: Mix chickpeas and pasta with canned tomatoes, top with cheese and bake.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C and cook the pasta for 2 minutes less than the packet says. Drain.
Drain and rinse the chickpeas.
In a baking dish, combine the pasta, chickpeas and canned tomatoes. Season with salt, pepper and dried herbs.
Scatter grated cheese evenly over the top.
Bake for 20 minutes until bubbling and golden on top.
recipes.tip: Undercooking the pasta first stops it going soft in the oven.

recipes.name: Peanut Butter Oat Smoothie
recipes.method: Blend peanut butter, oats, milk and banana into a smoothie.
steps: Add 1 cup of milk, ¼ cup of oats and 2 tablespoons of peanut butter to a blender.
Break in the banana — frozen banana makes it thick and cold.
Blend on high for 45–60 seconds until completely smooth.
Pour and drink straight away.
recipes.tip: Keep peeled banana chunks in the freezer for an instant milkshake texture.

recipes.name: Tuna Pasta Bake
recipes.method: Mix tuna and pasta with canned tomatoes, top with cheese and bake.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C. Cook the pasta for 2 minutes less than the packet says, then drain.
Drain the tuna and flake it.
Mix the pasta, tuna and canned tomatoes in a baking dish, and season well.
Top with plenty of grated cheese.
Bake for 20 minutes until golden and bubbling, then rest for 5 minutes before serving.
recipes.tip: Leftovers reheat brilliantly — portion it into containers for lunches.

recipes.name: Eggs on Toast
recipes.method: Fry or boil eggs, serve on toast with a slice of cheese.
steps: For boiled eggs: lower them into simmering water and cook for 6½ minutes for jammy yolks. For fried eggs: cook in an oiled pan over medium heat.
Toast the bread.
Lay a slice of cheese on the hot toast so it softens.
Top with the eggs and season with salt and pepper.
recipes.tip: Transfer boiled eggs straight into cold water — they'll peel far more easily.

recipes.name: Beef Mince Stuffed Potato
recipes.method: Bake potatoes, fill with cooked beef mince and onion, top with cheese.
steps: Bake the oiled, salted potatoes at 200°C for 45–50 minutes until tender.
Meanwhile brown the beef mince with the diced onion for 8–10 minutes, and season well.
Halve the potatoes, scoop out some of the flesh, and mix it into the mince.
Pile the mixture back into the skins and top with grated cheese.
Return to the oven for 5–8 minutes until the cheese melts.
recipes.tip: Add a spoon of canned tomatoes to the mince if you have some spare.

recipes.name: Lentil Rice Bowl
recipes.method: Cook lentils with onion and carrot, serve over rice.
steps: Rinse the lentils and simmer them in plenty of water for 20–25 minutes until tender, then drain.
Meanwhile cook the rice.
Fry the diced onion and carrot in oil for 6–8 minutes until soft and caramelised.
Stir the lentils into the onion and carrot, and season with salt, pepper and cumin.
Serve over the rice.
recipes.tip: Fry the onions slowly until deep brown — it turns a simple bowl into something special.

recipes.name: Almond Yogurt Bowl
recipes.method: Top Greek yogurt with chopped almonds, banana and apple.
steps: Spoon Greek yogurt into a bowl.
Roughly chop a small handful of almonds. Toast them in a dry pan for 2 minutes for extra crunch, if you like.
Slice the banana and dice the apple.
Top the yogurt with the fruit and almonds.
recipes.tip: Toasting the almonds takes 2 minutes and makes a big difference to the flavour.

recipes.name: Tofu Stir-Fry with Pasta
recipes.method: Stir-fry tofu with carrot, onion and mixed veg, toss through cooked pasta.
steps: Cook the pasta in salted water, then drain.
Press the tofu dry and cut it into cubes.
Fry the tofu in a hot oiled pan for 6–8 minutes, turning, until golden on all sides. Set aside.
Stir-fry the onion and carrot for 3 minutes, then add the frozen veg for 2 minutes.
Add the pasta and tofu, toss with soy sauce, and serve hot.
recipes.tip: Toss the tofu cubes in a little cornflour before frying for a crispier crust.

recipes.name: Chicken Salad Sandwich
recipes.method: Shred cooked chicken breast, mix with diced onion, serve in a sandwich.
steps: Poach the chicken breast in simmering salted water for 12–15 minutes until cooked through. Cool it slightly.
Shred the chicken with two forks.
Mix in finely diced onion and season. Add mayo or yogurt to bind, if you have some.
Pile onto bread and close the sandwich.
recipes.tip: Poach chicken on the weekend, then lunches take two minutes all week.

recipes.name: Cheese Omelette
recipes.method: Whisk eggs, cook with diced onion, fold in cheese for an omelette.
steps: Whisk 3 eggs with a pinch of salt and pepper.
Soften the finely diced onion in butter or oil in a non-stick pan for 2–3 minutes.
Pour in the eggs and gently pull the edges toward the centre as they set.
When the top is barely set, scatter grated cheese over one half.
Fold the omelette in half, slide it onto a plate, and serve straight away.
recipes.tip: Take it off the heat while it still looks slightly wet — it keeps cooking on the plate.

recipes.name: Salmon Jacket Potato
recipes.method: Bake potatoes, top with flaked canned salmon and a spoon of cottage cheese.
steps: Bake the oiled, salted potatoes at 200°C for 45–50 minutes.
Drain and flake the canned salmon.
Split the hot potatoes and fluff up the insides.
Top with salmon and a generous spoon of cottage cheese, then season with pepper.
recipes.tip: A squeeze of lemon and some black pepper really lifts the salmon.

recipes.name: Beef Mince Fried Rice
recipes.method: Brown beef mince, stir-fry with rice, carrot, onion and mixed veg.
steps: Cook the rice ahead and let it cool (or use leftover rice).
Brown the beef mince in a hot wok for 5–6 minutes until crisp, then set aside.
Stir-fry the diced onion and carrot for 3 minutes, then add the frozen mixed veg.
Add the rice and toss over high heat for 3–4 minutes.
Return the mince to the wok, season with soy sauce, and serve.
recipes.tip: Cook the mince until it gets crispy edges for texture against the soft rice.

recipes.name: Chickpea Salad
recipes.method: Toss chickpeas with diced onion and carrot, dress with olive oil.
steps: Drain and rinse the chickpeas.
Finely dice the onion and grate or dice the carrot.
Combine everything in a bowl.
Dress with olive oil, salt, pepper and a squeeze of lemon or a splash of vinegar. Toss well.
recipes.tip: Let it sit for 10 minutes before eating so the chickpeas soak up the dressing.

recipes.name: Baked Beans Jacket Potato
recipes.method: Bake potatoes, top with heated baked beans and grated cheese.
steps: Bake the oiled, salted potatoes at 200°C for 45–50 minutes until crisp outside and fluffy inside.
Heat the baked beans in a saucepan.
Split the potatoes and spoon the beans over them.
Top with grated cheese and let it melt.
recipes.tip: Microwave the potato for 8 minutes, then crisp it in the oven for 15, if you're short on time.

recipes.name: Tuna Baked Potato
recipes.method: Bake potatoes, top with canned tuna mixed with cottage cheese.
steps: Bake the oiled, salted potatoes at 200°C for 45–50 minutes.
Mix the drained tuna with the cottage cheese, and season with salt and pepper.
Split the potatoes and fluff up the insides.
Spoon the tuna mixture on top and serve.
recipes.tip: Add diced onion or some herbs to the tuna mix for extra freshness.

recipes.name: Peanut Butter Banana Toast
recipes.method: Spread peanut butter on toast, top with sliced banana.
steps: Toast the bread until golden.
Spread it thickly with peanut butter while it's still warm.
Slice the banana and layer it on top.
Finish with a sprinkle of cinnamon or a drizzle of honey if you like.
recipes.tip: Warm toast melts the peanut butter slightly — that's the magic.

recipes.name: Lentil Tomato Soup
recipes.method: Simmer lentils, canned tomatoes, onion and carrot into a soup.
steps: Soften the diced onion and carrot in oil in a large pot for 5–6 minutes.
Add the rinsed lentils, canned tomatoes and 4 cups of water or stock.
Bring to the boil, then simmer for 25–30 minutes until the lentils break down.
Season well. Blend partially for a creamy texture, or leave it chunky.
Serve hot, with toast if you have some.
recipes.tip: It freezes perfectly — make a double batch and freeze it in portions.

recipes.name: Tofu Curry
recipes.method: Simmer tofu and onion in canned tomatoes as a curry, serve with rice.
steps: Cook the rice.
Press the tofu dry and cut it into cubes. Pan-fry until golden, then set aside.
Soften the diced onion in oil, then stir in curry powder for 1 minute.
Add the canned tomatoes and simmer for 10 minutes, then add the tofu and simmer 5 more.
Season and serve over the rice.
recipes.tip: Frying the tofu first helps it hold its shape in the sauce.

recipes.name: Egg & Veg Fried Rice
recipes.method: Scramble eggs with fried rice, onion and frozen mixed veg.
steps: Use cold, cooked rice.
Scramble the beaten eggs in a hot oiled wok, then set aside.
Stir-fry the diced onion for 2 minutes, then add the frozen mixed veg for 3 minutes.
Add the rice and toss over high heat until it's piping hot.
Fold the egg back in, season with soy sauce, and serve.
recipes.tip: A drizzle of sesame oil at the end gives it a takeaway-style finish.

recipes.name: Almond Berry Yogurt
recipes.method: Top Greek yogurt with chopped almonds and frozen berries.
steps: Let the frozen berries thaw for 10 minutes, or microwave them for 30 seconds to make a quick compote.
Spoon the Greek yogurt into a bowl.
Top with the berries and their juices.
Scatter over the chopped almonds.
recipes.tip: Warm berries over cold yogurt is a lovely contrast — try it.

recipes.name: Beef Mince & Chickpea Stew
recipes.method: Brown beef mince with onion, add chickpeas and canned tomatoes, simmer as a stew.
steps: Brown the beef mince in a heavy pot for 6 minutes, breaking it up.
Add the diced onion and cook for 4 minutes until soft.
Stir in the drained chickpeas, canned tomatoes and ½ cup of water. Add paprika or cumin if you have them.
Simmer gently for 20–25 minutes until thick and rich.
Season to taste and serve on its own, with bread, or over rice.
recipes.tip: Like most stews, it's even better reheated the next day.
